_what: Setting or changing the signed-in account's password (read-data/verify-every-port-sign-in-set-password.mjs): the length limits, the strength rows the typing shows, the statuses and the words, and the two pages it sends a person to. Ported from the earlier code base's src/passwords.json, src/password-strength.mjs and the setPassword route in src/worker.mjs (b6ae0ebf815f). The brand word of the earlier taken_by_other line is removed here. The kept password's storage, its key-making cost and the try counter are not here.
